title: Sinker Side Burn: electrode wear compensation

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Found while merging main (#544 orbit, #545 Sinker Side Burn) into PR #1157 (#546, electrode wear compensation in Z).

**What happens now:** a Sinker Side Burn that states a measured electrode wear (`wear_lost` / `wear_over`) or a layer step is refused by name at every door - create, edit, paste, change-kind, the project reader and the generator: "electrode wear compensation is not supported on a Sinker Side Burn yet - clear the wear rate" (and "burning in layers is not supported on a Sinker Side Burn yet - clear the layer step"). A condition's stated `wear` is not applied to a side burn: its plunge stays uncompensated, as on main (shallower, never deeper).

**What is wanted:** the side burn's plunge compensated in Z the way the Sinker Burn's is (`motion::sinker_wear`: each layer's tip `(top-d)+gap-rate*d`, every move re-checked against the deepest compensated tip), with the lateral move made at the worn tip, and the side's allowance law (undersize less spark gap) judged with the worn electrode's side wear in mind. Open design point: whether lateral (side) wear of the electrode changes the allowance, or only its end wear is compensated.

**Safety floor:** changes posted Z and a gouge law, so `effort:high` at least.

Done means: a Side Burn with a stated wear rate generates a compensated plunge and lateral move, no move goes below the deepest compensated tip, the stock sim finds the finished cavity clean, the by-name refusal is removed, and tests pin each of these (motion + app `sinker_side`).

Part of #290. Follows #546 (PR #1157) and #545.

Label note: there is no `area:edm` label; `area:3d` follows #544/#545/#546.
